en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The thief, when he comes from his own self, repentant to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic, and returns the stolen goods to its owner, so there is not cutting (of the hand) upon him’.
